mappings.reason: Awarded for constant speed and perpendicular acceleration in circular motion.
Awarded for use of F=mv2/r to calculate friction force.
Comparison of speed and lap time for larger radius requires v=rw and w=2pi/T.
Awarded knowledge is definition of gravitational potential as work done per unit mass bringing mass from infinity, directly covered by this lesson.
Awarded knowledge is vector superposition of Earth and Moon gravitational fields (force per unit mass) cancelling to zero, covered by gravitational field definition lesson.
Awarded knowledge equates GM/x^2 for Earth and Moon to find zero-field point, which is recall and use of g=GM/r2.
Awarded knowledge calculates total potential as sum of -GM/r contributions from Earth and Moon, directly covered by phi=-GM/r lesson.
Awarded for defining specific heat capacity: energy per unit mass per unit temperature change.
Awarded for T=pV/Nk from pV=NkT equation of state for ideal gas.
Awarded for comparing pV=NkT with pV=1/3Nm<c2> to deduce average translational KE=3/2kT.
Awarded for internal energy as sum of molecular KE+PE and zero PE for ideal gas so equals total KE.
Awarded for first law deltaU=q+W with W=0 at constant volume so increase =Q.
Awarded for using specific heat capacity definition c=Q/NmDeltaT with DeltaU=N*3/2kDeltaT to get c=3k/2m.
Awarded for gas does work at constant pressure W=pDeltaV so more energy needed for same DeltaT, larger heat capacity.
Award is reading amplitude from displacement-time graph, covered by displacement, amplitude, period learning goals.
Award is omega=2pi/T from measured period, covered by angular frequency and period in terms of frequency goals.
Award is v0=omega*x0, covered by v=v0 cos wt and v=±omega sqrt(x0^2-x^2) lesson.
Awarded points are undamped then light damping from 12s, covered by damping and light damping lesson.
Award is closed v-L loop with correct L and v extrema, covered by graphical representations of displacement, velocity for SHM.

Awarded knowledge is advantages of digital transmission (noise removal, error-checking, encryption, multiplexing). No supplied lesson covers ADC/DAC or communication systems; controlled lessons are t12-t25 circular motion through cosmology only.
Awarded knowledge is 4-bit ADC sampling to bits 0101 at 4ms and 0100 at 8ms. No supplied lesson covers sampling, quantisation or ADC operation.
Awarded knowledge is DAC reconstruction as stepped hold levels. No supplied lesson covers DAC reconstruction.
Awarded knowledge is effect of changed sampling frequency and bit depth on reconstructed steps. No supplied lesson covers sampling frequency or bit resolution.
Part asks for Q=CV from C=Q/V and E=1/2QV=1/2CV2, directly covered by capacitance definition and capacitor energy lessons.
New capacitance from C inversely proportional to separation for parallel-plate capacitor, closest controlled lesson is capacitance as applied to parallel plate capacitors with C=Q/V.
Isolated disconnected capacitor retains charge QN=Q, application of C=Q/V capacitance conservation.
New p.d. VN=QN/CN from C=Q/V.
Change in energy stored W=1/2QV=1/2CV2 with constant Q and changed C/V, covered by capacitor energy lesson.

Awarded knowledge is properties of ideal op-amp (infinite gain, slew rate, input impedance, zero output impedance, bandwidth). No supplied lesson covers op-amps; supplied topics are 9702_t12-t25 without electronics.
Awarded knowledge is identification of X as thermistor and Y as relay in op-amp circuit. No supplied lesson covers these components or op-amp circuits.
Awarded knowledge is saturation of op-amp output due to input voltage difference. No supplied lesson covers op-amp saturation.
Awarded knowledge is naming comparator circuit. No supplied lesson covers comparator op-amp circuits.
Awarded knowledge is lamp lights when temperature above threshold set by comparator/thermistor circuit. No supplied lesson covers this op-amp switching application.
Awarded knowledge is purpose of variable resistor to adjust switching temperature. No supplied lesson covers this op-amp circuit control.

Awarded for F=BIL sin theta and calculation of B - directly recall and use F=BIL sin theta outcome.
Awarded for Fleming's left-hand rule direction to determine increase/decrease of force on current-carrying conductor.
Awarded for rotation due to opposite forces on vertical sides - application of force on current-carrying conductor with Fleming direction.
(a) defines r.m.s. voltage by reference to mean power in resistive load, matching mean power half maximum and rms vs peak lesson.

(c) connects load so induced current creates force opposing rotation per Lenz's law, matching induced e.m.f. direction to oppose change.

Awarded knowledge is calculation using lambda = h/mv, direct application of de Broglie wavelength recall and use.

Awarded advantage 3D image and disadvantage greater exposure for CT scanning versus single X-ray, directly the CT scanning learning goal.
